## ✅ Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] Base branch is correct (`develop` or `main`) and up to date
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, …)
- [ ] Tests / CI pass and expected behavior has been verified
- [ ] No debug logs, commented-out code, or exposed secrets
- [ ] Changes have been self-reviewed and are ready to merge
- [ ] At least 1 reviewer has been assigned
